title: A PASS confirms on a disjoint/most-recent window before it can feed Tier-3; drop the same-window FAIL replay for deterministic template cells
note: [2026-10-16 RESEARCH-OPS-BENCHMARK-1016] GAP (benchmark docs/research/research-ops-benchmark-2026-10-16.md section 2; S4, S8.4, S20). MEASURED: scripts/research/queue_grade.py docstring + confirm path (lines ~30-45, ~316-335): a template unit's first FAIL resets last_dispatched_at for a confirmatory re-run over the same window (deterministic replay; the hand path already dropped this for that reason), while a PASS closes done. P3 already applies 'best-of-3 PASS opens exactly one fresh-window confirmation, no Tier-3 until CONFIRMED' (row P3-STRATEGY-PROGRAMME) -- generalise it. Skill text landed in the benchmark PR (research-ops section D 'pass ->'). TOOLING SCOPE (Tier-1, after operator answers decision 2 in the benchmark): grader emits a confirmation unit (requires_result on the PASS, window = most recent N months not in the PASS window) for template/sweep PASS cells; FAIL on deterministic harnesses closes without replay (the family-retirement protocol, not the replay, protects ideas). FIRST STEP: measure over research/queue the template units with confirmatory_run: 1 -- how many confirmatory reads repeated the first verdict (if ~100%, the replay is wasted slots; quantify slot-hours). roadmap L-PROGRAMMES. [2026-10-16 RESEARCH-CONFIRM-FRESH-WINDOW-1016] OPERATOR DECISION, 2026-10-16, by popup: "Yes, adopt". This is the replication policy: (a) A single-window PASS on a template cell is a discovery. It opens exactly one fresh-window confirmation unit (a disjoint or most-recent window) before it can feed any Tier-3 proposal. The unit's note names how many cells the PASS was selected from. (b) For deterministic harnesses, drop queue_grade.py's same-window replay of a template's first FAIL. A FAIL still never retires a family; the family-retirement protocol (#18557) owns that. (Relayed by Manager Session 2026-10-16, session_01VduHYzdaXe27wTDBLSu8ao.) FIRST-STEP MEASUREMENT (main, 2026-10-16): 0 of 176 generated units carry grading.confirmatory_run -- the same-window replay never fired on a template cell, so (b) frees no measured slot-hours; it removes a latent path. Template PASSes on main: 0 once-cells; 16 m20-exit-lever monthly cells read pass (13 queued, 3 retired). IMPLEMENTATION: scripts/research/queue_grade.py (confirmation_unit / decide) + dispatch_queue.py not_before gate; dry run on main would open 13 m20 confirmation units (split_mode=date, split = day after the PASS data, not_before = PASS + 60d, selected_from 16-25 cells each). [2026-10-16 12:20Z RESEARCH-CONFIRM-FRESH-WINDOW-1016] MERGED #18593 as 5a415623 (merged, not yet observed). CLOSING OBSERVATION: the first research-queue-grade run after merge (a) adds the expected m20 confirmation units (dry run on main measured 13: one per queued m20 PASS cell, each requires_result on its PASS, not_before = PASS data end + 60d) and (b) closes at least one deterministic template FAIL done with no same-window replay (no last_dispatched_at: null, no confirmatory_run). FOLLOW-UPS filed: PI-20261016-QOTFUEXV-0001 (template rule prose for prop-fit/roster still says a FAIL re-queues), PI-20261016-QOTFUEXV-0002 (fresh-window inputs for e35/prop-fit/roster; m20 --cells for the parent cells), PI-20261016-QOTFUEXV-0003 (MEASURED: the 60-day forward wait yields 0.7-13.9 OOS trades vs the 25 floor for all 13 m20 PASSes, so every confirmation would grade indeterminate at day 60; backward-disjoint is not available because the sweep uses all held history; fix due before the earliest not_before, 2026-11-28). [2026-10-16 ~13:30Z RESEARCH-CONFIRM-FRESH-WINDOW-1016] OPERATOR DECISION (popup, 2026-10-16 ~12:45Z, relayed by the manager), answer "Holdout re-run", verbatim: "From now on, each sweep holds back the most recent ~25% of history before it chooses settings, then tests the winner on that held-back part, so discovery and confirmation come from one run with no wait. The 13 current passes get re-run that way now, within days. Cost: each choice is made on 25% less data." BUILD on branch claude/m20-holdout-confirm-1016: pre-registered holdout in m20_fleet_exit_sweep (+ m20_holdout.py lookahead guard, workflow input holdout_frac default 0.25), corpus/E5 pass-through, queue_grade holdout-aware confirmation (holdout re-run instead of forward wait for m20; forward wait sized per leg; superseded forward units retired), and 13 holdout re-run units RQ-20261016-d37f-01..13 (one per m20 PASS leg; shares 0.25-0.34 to reach the 25-trade floor, estimated from corpus lifetimes). Pipeline PI-20261016-QOTFUEXV-0003 routed to it.  [2026-10-22 17:55Z manager session_01Hsp3aD8ccAyhHiyYARqEqh] #18593 + #18614 MERGED (2026-10-16); lane name only, no live session. in_flight 6d untouched (inflight alarm) -> landed_unproven with the observation above.
